title: Few-copy block decoding with a finite Poisson window

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the bounded subset-fiber decoder in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and k=n when 50*2^n >= 99*N or when n >= 576 and 4*2^n >= 5*N, and k=n+1 otherwise, acquires k independent ideal copies and recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The same configuration jointly has branchwise total charged work O(2^(n/2) n^2 (1+log2 log2(n+2))), hence the supported envelope O(2^(n/2) n^2 (log2 n)^(1/8)), with growth index exactly 1.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the bounded subset-fiber decoder in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and k=n when 50*2^n >= 99*N or when n >= 576 and 4*2^n >= 5*N, and k=n+1 otherwise, acquires k independent ideal copies and recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The same configuration jointly has peak allocated classical space O(n^2) bits on every branch, with growth index exactly 0.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the bounded subset-fiber decoder in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and k=n when 50*2^n >= 99*N or when n >= 576 and 4*2^n >= 5*N, and k=n+1 otherwise, acquires k independent ideal copies and recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The same configuration jointly has peak allocated quantum space O(n) qubits on every branch, with growth index exactly 0.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the bounded subset-fiber decoder in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and k=n when 50*2^n >= 99*N or when n >= 576 and 4*2^n >= 5*N, and k=n+1 otherwise, acquires k independent ideal copies and recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The same configuration jointly has acquisition count exactly k on every branch, which is O(n) and has growth index exactly 0.

For every N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the bounded subset-fiber decoder in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N) and k=n when 50*2^n >= 99*N or when n >= 576 and 4*2^n >= 5*N, and k=n+1 otherwise, acquires k independent ideal copies and recovers all of s with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The same configuration jointly has guaranteed malformed fraction epsilon(n)=0, requiring independent ideal copies.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
